name: @game-hub/ui-kit
description: Game Hub's shared board chrome: the frames every game's board renders inside (TurnBanner, ActivityFeed, GameOver, ActionTip, PanZoom, Button, Card), the seat-binding rule (seatIdentity), the `cn` class merger, and the game-facing REST helpers a client calls (getGame/applyAction/unwrap/fail). Styled with Tailwind v4 utility classes over the host's semantic tokens — a host adds one `@source` line so its Tailwind build scans this package. In-workspace it is consumed as TypeScript source; the published tarball resolves the same entry to dist/ via publishConfig.
